task.target_gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition (sm_120)

capture.cookbook_command: python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path <snap> --trust-remote-code --tp-size 1 --disable-radix-cache --mem-fraction-static 0.85 --max-running-requests 8 --cuda-graph-max-bs 8 --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --speculative-algorithm DSPARK --speculative-draft-model-path RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-0811-DSpark-Stage2 --speculative-dspark-block-size 8
capture.measured_share: fp4 GEMM 40.7% of DSpark verify step / 50.5% of plain decode; act-quant kernels a further ~3%

benchmark.timing: triton.testing.do_bench around a captured CUDA graph, L2 cold, interleaved A/B

qwen38_fp4_gemm.note: SGLang ships no dedicated mm_fp4 test; this is the same fallback tolerance its linear-attention tests use for a bf16 output built from a low-precision accumulation.

qwen38_fp4_quantize.note: A quantizer's outputs are packed nibbles and e4m3 scale blocks, and a split/reshape/cat only moves bytes: any difference is a different encoding, not rounding. Bit-exact or wrong.

qwen38_silu_fp4_quantize.note: A quantizer's outputs are packed nibbles and e4m3 scale blocks, and a split/reshape/cat only moves bytes: any difference is a different encoding, not rounding. Bit-exact or wrong.

correctness.policy: rtol/atol are copied from SGLang's own test for each kernel (source cited per op). Do not loosen them in a task; if a tolerance is wrong, fix it upstream and re-copy.
notes: `qwen38_silu_fp4_quantize` returns a scale block in the 6-D swizzled layout padded to 128-row tiles; the padding rows are never written, so the gate covers the written rows only (tools/gates.py::written_scale_rows). Comparing the whole tensor fails the reference against itself wherever T % 128 != 0.
`out_dtype` and `out_features` are scalars the shape capture cannot record and are rebuilt in baseline/entry.py::RECONSTRUCT, as is the transposed weight view mm_fp4 requires.

workload.real_tensor_coverage: 16 rows,   6 with payload ( 38%),   10/  45 data args real ( 22%)
